pages.en: It's a sunny day, so the family has a picnic in the park. Mum brings sandwiches and fruit. Dad brings a bottle of lemonade.
pages.zh: 天气晴朗，一家人在公园野餐。妈妈带了三明治和水果，爸爸带了一瓶柠檬水。
pages.scene: Mum, Dad, Lily, Tom and Max on a checked picnic blanket in a sunny park, sandwiches, fruit and a bottle of lemonade.

pages.en: Tom eats a cheese sandwich and some strawberries. Lily wants a slice of chocolate cake, but Max wants it too!
pages.zh: Tom 吃了一个奶酪三明治和一些草莓。Lily 想吃一块巧克力蛋糕，可是 Max 也想吃！
pages.scene: Lily holding a slice of chocolate cake while Max looks up at it hopefully, Tom eating a sandwich with strawberries.

pages.en: "No, Max! Chocolate is bad for dogs," says Lily. She gives him a dog biscuit. Max is happy, and Lily eats her cake.
pages.zh: “不行，Max！巧克力对狗不好。”Lily 说。她给了 Max 一块狗饼干。Max 很开心，Lily 吃了她的蛋糕。
pages.scene: Lily giving Max a bone-shaped dog biscuit, Max happily wagging his tail, the chocolate cake safely on her plate.

questions.q: The family has a picnic on the beach.

questions.zh: Lily 给了 Max 什么？
